notes.title: Mac version released!(beta)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We've updated the Mac version on Steam.

After some basic testing, the game is generally playable. However, since we haven't conducted detailed testing, there may be some unknown issues.

We appreciate your understanding.

notes.title: Last update before release!
notes.notes:
After nine months of earnest development, with constant revisions and redesigns, our game is finally set to launch.

This version predominantly offers exhilarating "fun-play". During beta testing, some players mentioned that the game may be a bit simple, but its thrilling pace was well received. If you've played Slay the Spire or Monster Train, our game is more akin to a faster-paced Monster Train. Battles are quick, and each growth opportunity is ample.

Huge thanks to all the players who tirelessly participated in our testing phases. Additional thanks to the independent game developers and publishers who constantly provided us with feedback during development.

We hope this innovative dove-themed card game brings you much joy!

Here's the translation for the Steam community:
"After a journey of 9 months from our prototype to the final demo, facing multiple design overturns, our game is finally launching.

The overall version primarily offers a thrilling 'fun experience'. During our beta, some players noted potential simplicity, but the exhilarating gameplay was universally acknowledged. If you've played Slay the Spire and Monster Train, our game stands as a more straightforward version of a faster-paced Monster Train. Each battle is concise, and each progression phase is rewarding.

A huge thank you to all players who tirelessly participated in the testing phases. Also, immense gratitude to independent game developers and publishers who constantly provided revision feedback during our development process.

We hope this innovative dove-themed card game brings you immense joy!"
